purpose: predict a continuous-by-circular ecological state jointly and separate contextual joint value from directional cross-state coupling value

state_roles.z: one real-valued continuous ecological state such as measured height or depth
state_roles.t: one explicitly periodic ecological state such as local clock time

training_joint_comparator: p_train(t) p_train(z|t), preserving overall z-t organization while discarding X
coupling_interpretation: predictive value of realized t for z after X is already known; directional and non-causal

reference_factorization.height_given_context_and_time: weighted linear-Gaussian density with X plus sin(t) and cos(t)
reference_factorization.height_given_time_comparator: weighted linear-Gaussian density with sin(t) and cos(t) only

prediction_outputs: mean circular state and wrapping prediction arc
continuous-state mean and interval conditional on the predicted circular mode
Monte Carlo samples from the autoregressive joint density

external_learner_interface.joint_minimum_requirement: held-out conditional joint and X-free training-joint marginal log density
external_learner_interface.coupling_requirement: factorized contextual log density p(t|X)p(z|X) in addition to joint contextual density

obligations: stable family has positive contextual joint gain in every replicate
stable family has positive directional coupling gain in every replicate
context-unorganized family has absolute mean contextual joint gain below 0.02
contextual-but-uncoupled family has absolute mean directional coupling gain below 0.02
context-shifted family has negative contextual joint gain in every replicate
coupling-shifted family has negative directional coupling gain in every replicate
common time phase-origin shift preserves both gains to absolute error <= 1e-10
equivalent hour-to-minute period conversion preserves both gains to absolute error <= 1e-10
positive affine change of continuous-state units preserves both gains to absolute error <= 1e-10

out_of_scope: multivariate continuous vector state density beyond one z and one t
